positions.as_written: Protect and restore full extension after any knee injury or operation, because the locking position depends on the last few degrees.
Expect a knee that cannot fully extend to fatigue the quadriceps in standing, and treat the extension rather than the muscle.
Avoid quoting terminal rotation as a precise figure, since the published range is wide relative to the quantity.
Treat terminal extension as a design and a technical target.
Place the femoral tunnel to allow terminal extension, and check it on the table.
Consider component rotation when a replaced knee loses terminal extension without mechanical obstruction.
